activity.notes: Dhu Nuwas is the later Arabic name of the Himyarite king Yusuf As'ar Yath'ar. Peer-reviewed scholarship places his reign in 522–525 CE and identifies him as the last independent Himyarite king before the Aksumite conquest. ATLAS uses the historical Himyarite kingdom rather than a generic Arabia polity.

sources.title: Lasse Løvlund Toft, Dhū Nuwās and the Martyrs of Najrān in Islamic Arabic Literature until 1400 AD
sources.citation_text: The peer-reviewed article identifies Yusuf As'ar Yath'ar, known as Dhu Nuwas, as the last king of Himyar and gives his reign as 522–525 CE.

review_context.correction_note: Register the epigraphically and historically attested Himyarite kingship.
